verdict.rationale: Sentry is a SaaS platform with AI features (Seer), so a buyer can fairly ask whether there is an AI-training opt-out. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy or control that keeps customer data out of model training. Self-hosting keeps data on your own servers, but that is an adjacent deployment option rather than a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
